sections.section_content:
[Table 4. SRAM sizes]
These SRAMs can be accessed as bytes, half-words (16 bits), or full words (32 bits). These
memories can be addressed both by CPU and DMAs.
The CPU can access the SRAM1 and SRAM2 through the system bus or through the C-bus
depending on the selected address. SRAM features are detailed in Section5.3.1: Internal
SRAMs features.
